title.zh: 德意志银行计划在欧洲为机构客户提供比特币、以太币托管服务
title.en: Deutsche Bank plans bitcoin, ether custody for institutional clients in Europe

current_state.zh: 德意志银行已获得BaFin的MiCA授权，正准备在德国推出面向机构客户的加密托管服务，初期支持比特币、以太币及部分稳定币（包括USDC、EURC、EURAU），并计划2027年拓展亚洲金融中心；此前规划的法币与稳定币兑换、代币化存款和数字债券发行仍待后续推进。
current_state.en: Deutsche Bank has received BaFin authorization under MiCA and is preparing to launch crypto custody for institutional clients in Germany, initially supporting bitcoin, ether and select stablecoins including USDC, EURC and EURAU, with plans to expand into Asian financial hubs in 2027; previously outlined fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, tokenized deposits and digital bond issuance remain to follow.

updates.title_zh: 德意志银行筹备在德国推出加密托管服务，并着眼亚洲：报道
updates.title_en: Deutsche Bank prepares German crypto custody launch, eyes Asia: Report
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增：据ESMA临时MiCA登记册，德意志银行已于周一获得德国联邦金融监管局（BaFin）的加密托管授权；初期上线地点明确为德国，并将AllUnity EUR（EURAU）纳入初期支持的稳定币；该行企业银行业务目标为到2028年实现8%的复合年增长。
updates.what_changed_en: New: per ESMA's interim MiCA register, Deutsche Bank received crypto custody authorization from Germany's BaFin on Monday; the initial launch is specified for Germany and AllUnity EUR (EURAU) is included among initial stablecoins; the bank targets 8% compound annual growth in corporate banking by 2028.
updates.current_state_zh: 德意志银行已获得BaFin的MiCA授权，正准备在德国推出面向机构客户的加密托管服务，初期支持比特币、以太币及部分稳定币（包括USDC、EURC、EURAU），并计划2027年拓展亚洲金融中心；此前规划的法币与稳定币兑换、代币化存款和数字债券发行仍待后续推进。
updates.current_state_en: Deutsche Bank has received BaFin authorization under MiCA and is preparing to launch crypto custody for institutional clients in Germany, initially supporting bitcoin, ether and select stablecoins including USDC, EURC and EURAU, with plans to expand into Asian financial hubs in 2027; previously outlined fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, tokenized deposits and digital bond issuance remain to follow.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Deutsche Bank is reportedly preparing to launch crypto custody services in Germany, initially supporting Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins, with plans to extend the offering to Asian financial centers in 2027 as part of its corporate-banking growth strategy.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Deutsche Bank is reportedly preparing to launch crypto custody services in Germany, initially supporting Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins, with plans to extend the offering to Asian financial centers in 2027 as part of its corporate-banking growth strategy.
